description: Focused modernization task plan for upgrading the Selenium framework Java runtime to Java 25.

tasks.description: Upgrade the Selenium framework Java runtime and compiler target from Java 17 to Java 25 while preserving existing behavior.
tasks.reason: The assessment identifies Java 17 as the project's current target, and the user explicitly requested a Java 25 runtime upgrade.
tasks.requirements: Address assessment issue azure-java-version-02000 (“Java Version is not the latest LTS”), verified in pom.xml where maven.compiler.release is 17. Upgrade only the Java runtime/compiler target to Java 25. Update directly related build, runtime/toolchain, documentation, and configuration surfaces only where they exist, and preserve application and test behavior. Do not upgrade unrelated frameworks or dependencies, and do not include hardcoded-URL or Docker/containerization findings. Validate with a clean Maven verification build and the existing TestNG tests on JDK 25; report if that environment is unavailable.
